messages:
Alice Chen: heads-up — noticed a throughput dip on the int4+fp8 variant for the 13B longseq benchmark this morning (seq_len=2048). numbers look like ~18% lower tokens/s vs last week's run. anyone on bench-data who can take a quick async look?
bench-bot: auto-report: 13B-int4+fp8 — run 2026-03-17T09:12Z — avg tokens/s=1024 — p50 latency=45ms — mem util=83% — full logs: https://redwood.internal/bench/2309456789/logs
Mateo Rivera: I can dig in. quick Q — is this observed only at seq_len=2048 or shorter too?
Alice Chen: only at 2048+ so far. shorter sequences (512/1024) look within normal variance.
Mateo Rivera: ok good hint. I ran a micro profiling pass earlier — seems like KV cache churn + larger attention windows cause repeated kernel launches and some GPU stalls. rough snapshot: nvprof shows small peaks aligned to past-kernel memcpy.
Priya Singh: fyi I pushed a flag for kv-warm to be enabled in the canary image earlier today for a different test. can we try toggling prefix caching and see if tokens/s recovers?
Jamal Ortiz: I can run a dedicated canary on a single GPU node if bench infra is ok with that. priority?
Alice Chen: priority P2 for now but would like a quick determination (degraded perf vs correctness) before EOD. Jamal that'd be helpful.
Mateo Rivera: running a local microbench now with kv-warm=true and batch_size tweak (bs=1->2). command I'm using:
```
./run_bench --model 13B --quant int4_fp8 --seq_len 2048 --kv_warm true --batch 2 --profile nvlink
```
Mateo Rivera: initial run up: tokens/s improved to ~1180 (so ~15% better). still shy of baseline but closer. p50 latency up slightly due to larger batches.
Priya Singh: thanks. question on quality: do we have eval diffs for int4+fp8 at this sequence length? I can re-run the promptset overnight but need a quick delta to decide rollout gating.
Alice Chen: the quick eval we ran last week on the canonical promptset showed top-1 token mismatch ~0.9% vs fp16 for int4+fp8 at seq=512. not sure about 2048.
Priya Singh: ran a targeted sample of 200 prompts at 2048 earlier this morning — token mismatch ~1.1%, median logprob diff small. for user-facing outputs looks like occasional token slips in long tails but no whole-answer corruption.
Jamal Ortiz: sounds tolerable for beta customers but would not push to strict SLA tiers. ops-bot — any capacity constraints if we run a short warm-canary today?
ops-bot: scheduling ok — can allocate 1 x a100-80GB for 30m window starting 2026-03-17T13:00Z. please confirm.
Alice Chen: confirmed. Jamal, Mateo — can you coordinate to run the warm-canary and capture nvprof + kernel timeline + perf counters? please upload artifacts to the bench link.
Mateo Rivera: will do. I'll capture kernel timeline + memcpy traces and a small flame graph.
Priya Singh: I will kick off a 2k sample eval overnight and post summary in this thread tomorrow AM. if mismatch >2% we gate.
Jamal Ortiz: running now, tagging @Mateo for handoff. :thumbsup:
bench-bot: canary run started: id=canary-2309456789-1 — results will auto-post when complete.
Alice Chen: awesome — thanks all. if we see persistent >10% throughput loss after caching tweaks, we'll open a follow-up to consider kernel fusion or a fallback routing rule. otherwise keep this thread for async updates. :eyes:
